title: Robbery 101
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC Asia-India Finals Mirror Contest 2016
statement: You are the most notorious criminal in **Gwalior**. You've decided that you're going to rob hard working employees of **CF**, a famous Tech company in the city. There are **N** people working in **CF**. The employees working here are conveniently numbered from **1** to **N**.
